scope: OQL $parameters, multi-step association paths and enumeration keys through the Marketplace OQL module actions

native.toolchain: Linux MxBuild portable app and Mendix Runtime via script/oql_native_oracle; OQL module sources from MXRB_OQL_MODULE_SOURCE

native_semantics: the module keeps parameters per thread until ExecuteOQLStatement or CountRowsOQLStatement runs; preserveParameters keeps them
an empty parameter in = behaves as IS NULL, like the NULL literal; text parameters compare and LIKE case-insensitively
amount and offset page after ORDER BY; amount 0 is unlimited
multi-step association paths join every entity on the way; LEFT keeps rows with any missing step
enumeration attributes read as their keys
limitations: multi-step paths with RIGHT or FULL joins are rejected
an unset parameter is an error in Ruby; the native behavior was not exercised
